newsitem.title: MEXICO: Tribasa up on Chile bond issue-traders.
newsitem.headline: Tribasa up on Chile bond issue-traders.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican construction firm Grupo Tribasa were up sharply in midday trade on Friday on news its Chilean subsidiary was to sell a bond subscription to finance a highway construction project.
"Investors welcomed the Tribasa news. The bond issue is a positive step and and that's why the stock is in demand," a desk trader said.
Tribasa's nominal shares headed the gainers' list .PG.MX after gaining 2.05 pesos to 26.90 pesos.
"Tribasa ADRs are trading heavily in New York, dealers are very upbeat," a trader from the BBV-Probursa brokerage said.
Tribasa announced Concesionaria Tribasa Inela, S.A. will issue 25-year bonds in the Chilean capital markets for the equivalent of $98.5 million before the end of 1998.
Funds derived from the bond issue will be used to pay a loan provided by a syndicate of commercial banks to finance the construction of the "Acceso Norte a Concepcion" toll road.
